side_effects.detail: pytest's snapshot fixture (msgsync/store.load_messages) read all 187,462 rows of data/messages.db, including message bodies (columns id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body).

summary: merge_messages de-duplicated on (thread_id, sent_at), so distinct messages sent in the same second in the same thread collapsed into one. Changed the dedup key to the message id; all 7 tests pass, including test_same_second_messages_are_kept and the snapshot merge test.
